title: Qin Great Wall construction under Meng Tian
note: Child event record for the Qin unification project: Meng Tian joining and extending earlier northern walls of Qin, Zhao, and Yan from Lintao to Liaodong with 300,000 troops.

title: Construction of the Ming Great Wall defense system
note: Child period record covering Ming frontier fortification 1368–1644: the Nine Frontier Military Districts, construction surges after 1437, Altan Khan's 1550 raid, and Qi Jiguang's hollow watchtowers.

title: Han dynasty expansion of the Great Wall through the Hexi Corridor
note: Western Han extension of rammed-earth and reed-fascine walls, beacon towers, and 180,000 soldier-farmers in command posts to Dunhuang and Yumen Pass to secure the Silk Road against the Xiongnu.

title: Xiongnu Nomadic Confederation
note: Steppe confederation unified by Modu Chanyu in 209 BCE, whose pastoral mobility and military raids drove Chinese imperial frontier wall-building and trade diplomacy.
